content.text: Now validating redlines for the deviations.

input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual and add standard uncapped carve-outs
input.comment: [Playbook] We need the cap to run both ways: as drafted TrueLink is capped while Client's liability is unlimited. We have made the 12-month fee cap mutual and placed confidentiality, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirmed Client's payment obligations are not caught by it.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IS NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.

input.summary: Add Vendor IP-infringement, breach-of-law, data-breach and misconduct indemnity
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity covers only its own breach and does not clearly reach third-party IP infringement claims arising from the Interface, while Client's indemnity is very broad. We have added the standard vendor indemnity for infringement, breach of law, unauthorised access to Client data and wilful misconduct.

ops.text: TrueLink shall further defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content, Client Proprietary Information or Credit Data caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

input.summary: Add successor/M&A carve-out and reasonableness standard to assignment consent
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a consent requirement that blocks assignment to a successor in a merger or sale of assets; we have added the M&A carve-out (on notice) and a reasonableness standard for any other consent.

ops.oldText: without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or, in the case of Client, to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, upon written notice to the other party.

input.summary: Narrow the Credit Data licence to service delivery and confirm Client ownership of its data and IP
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot grant TrueLink rights to distribute, license, resell or otherwise exploit data originating with Client and its borrowers; the licence is narrowed to what is needed to deliver the services and we have confirmed that Client retains ownership of Client Content, Client Intellectual Property and Client data.

ops.oldText: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
ops.newText: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive, worldwide right and license to use, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data solely as necessary to provide the Hosting Services and Support Services to Client during the term of this Agreement, subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement. As between the parties, Client retains all right, title and interest in and to Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or its customers (including Credit Data), and no ownership interest therein is assigned to or jointly held by TrueLink.
